ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast with approximately 90-95% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels and 5-10% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous light-grey circular clusters located at the distal posterior sections of both lobes; a smaller light-grey patch is visible on the inner lower margin of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped indentation at the central axis; estimated pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing boundary; multiple distinct larger notches (irregular peaks) visible on the right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature of the anterior edges leading to sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular, light-colored pixels (rosettes) concentrated near the outer tips of both lobes, particularly prominent on the far-left and mid-right fluke sections.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct horizontal white linear marks on the upper mid-section of the left lobe and several fine diagonal white lines on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular grey scarring patterns consistent with parasitic attachment or barnacle colonization sites; multiple linear scratch marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white speckling (individual high-intensity pixels) distributed across the dark background of both lobes.
